card.title: I Learned It the Hard Way
card.instruction: Treat experience with the system as seniority. Teach its shortcuts, warn against its traps, and remind everyone that your mistakes came first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring a sandwich to the permit office. I lost three Tuesdays learning that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says appointments take ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After they check your documents. Get that done at the side door; that was Tuesday two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask reception to call the document clerk out. Don't follow the clerk back inside. Tuesday three was mostly explaining myself.

mechanism: A teaches permit-office shortcuts and access traps by citing the sequence of Tuesdays lost learning them first.
confusable: Unlike abstract expertise, A grounds system seniority in specific earlier mistakes and gives the novice actionable ways around them.
comparison: The permit alternative warns how to use a staff-door contact without entering; the committee alternative offers A's predecessor report on the ladder process.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
